about_the_game:
ㅤ

Born in an ancient Korean kingdom, Nammo grew up under the warm and loving care of Junjeong, who was like a sister to her. The two became beloved by their people, and blossomed into flower-like beauties. But fate twisted cruelly beneath the moonlight. With nothing but sorrow in her eyes, Junjeong struck, slashing Nammo’s eyes and leaving her blind. After waking up in an unfamiliar cave, Nammo starts on a journey to uncover the truth behind Junjeong's betrayal.

ㅤ

'NAMMO' is a 2D Soulslike game set in a Korean Dark Fantasy world, depicting a desperate struggle against overwhelming bosses. Battle monstrous kings, crazed warriors, and immortal spirits. Each enemy will push you to the brink of despair with unique attack patterns and devastating power. Master precise parries and sharp counterattacks to survive the battles.

ㅤ

Enter the Spirit Realm to uncover your enemies' hidden weaknesses and discover pathways invisible to the naked eye. With 'The Eyes of Spirit', you can reveal the fatal weaknesses of bosses and discover secret routes unseen in the physical realm. Successfully destroying a boss's weakness can cause both physical damage and disable even their most dangerous attacks. While using hidden platforms and shortcuts can give you a strategic advantage over your enemies. Combine a tactical position with perfect timing, and you can bring down even the most challenging enemies and claim your victory.

ㅤ

Look closely into the allies standing before you. What you discover through 'The Eyes of Spirit' will dramatically alter both your journey's path and the battles ahead. A single glimpse can turn a trusted companion into an enemy, or reveal a suspected foe as your truest ally. Appearances deceive, words can lie, but souls cannot hide. Every encounter holds hidden meaning, and only 'The Eyes of Spirit' can reveal their true intentions. Once the truth is seen, there is no return. Bearing it becomes part of Nammo’s fate.

ㅤ

When mighty bosses fall, their power remains. Nammo absorbs the souls of her defeated enemies, gaining their abilities as her own. Mix and match different souls to craft your unique combat style and become the legend you choose to be.

Play through and master 'The Eyes of Spirit' to expose weaknesses, defeat bosses with precise parries, and absorb their souls to forge your own combat style.
